title: Robert N NDE 3680
content: At age seven, while swimming (I had not really learned yet) in a motel swimming pool, I found I could not get my head above water. I swam underwater to the edge and tried to pull myself up. The ceramic tile border was slippery, and I could not get a grip on it. I was drowning. At this time, I started to see myself struggling from a perspective from below and behind me. This visualizing continued until, at the last moment, I was finally able to gain a grip, and was able to pull my head above the water.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No drowning 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death'
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal For about thirty seconds prior to being able to breathe.
elements.At what time during the experience were: For about thirty seconds prior to being able to breathe.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Though my thoughts sped up, it was as if it was in slow motion too. No concept of lapsed time.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Very clear, sharp, and bright colors.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Panic, but also an awareness that this experience was exceptional, even as a seven year old.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I was to have a few dreams of some future events, and had two more 'out of body' experiences.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Though I was panicked, I was aware that the experience was very special. I've had more since.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain Dreams of future events. Two OBEs. Many times correctly knowing who was calling on the phone.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I could see myself as though I was a third party.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Uncertain I believe after it happened I tried to explain it to my parents, brother, and my cousin.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I viewed it for what it was. I knew it had happened.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I will always remember it as though it was yesterday. Plus, it happened again in 1985 and 1989.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes As noted above, other instances of similar occurrences, and the dreams. You don't forget them, they get your attention.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: In the three out of body experiences, the visual perspective was always from behind me. The clarity of the memories in these experiences is amazing.
